card.title: SAIB: MRNA — Moderna
card.summary: Moderna (MRNA) as a Single AI Index Basket (SAIB): a one-stock index whose index price IS the MRNA share price (one share = one index share, in USD). Every position is backed 1:1 by real MRNA shares held through Brokerage100, so you trade the stock's move directly — no options, no expiry, no leverage. Trades during US market hours; the tokenized index share (EVCDX) trades on the exchange once minted.

tradeability.tradeable_now: True when a position can be opened on this card RIGHT NOW via POST /buy, /sell or /short (paper or live per your account mode); False carries trading_blocked_reason. This is the only trade gate.
tradeability.pipeline_status: Progress of the card's on-chain EVCDX token listing on the pro order-book terminal (token deploy, pair, liquidity). Informational; it never gates buy/sell/short and can lag tradeable_now.
